results.notes: Searched county library sites: only the Fairview branch page, old program PDFs and MX listings. No page for this club; Bookmarked is a separate Zoom club.
Searched name + seed swap/Rabbit Hole: Meetup only. Other Asheville garden clubs (federated clubs, WNC Seed & Plant Swap) are different groups.
Black Mountain nonprofit's own site: support groups and peer mentorship for stroke survivors and caregivers; search confirms its groups meet at ACNC, 216 Asheland Ave.
Searched name + sound bath/Lexington Ave/polyvagal: Meetup and event aggregators only. Facilitator Vivek Chugh's taplink is personal, not the group's.
Play Sport and Social runs the Asheville Sport & Social Club (ASSC) leagues; its Asheville volleyball page names ASSC co-ed sand volleyball. theassc.com is parked.
Searched: only Mountain Xpress and Town of Weaverville single-event listings. No group page.
Searched name + Clyde/walks: Meetup only (Clyde NC, ~380 members). No own site or social page.
City drop-in program at Southside Community Center; searches found only MX listings and general city park pages, no program page.
Searched name + Asheville/Raven and Crone: only an unrelated Atlanta 'Modern Mystic' shop. Meetup only.
Searched name/Asheville Atheists/facebook: Meetup only. WNC Humanists is a separate sister group; guessed domains don't resolve.
Searched: only MX listings and the general Swannanoa Library branch page (not club-specific).
Searched name + 20s 30s 40s Asheville: only Meetup and other social groups. No own site.
Searched name + Character Study: only unrelated 'Practical Philosophy' meetups in other cities. Meetup only.
Searched name/Cork & Keg/facebook: nothing. Swing Asheville and Asheville Swing Night sites don't list this Balboa night, so not linked.
Searched name + Asheville/Hendersonville: Meetup only.
Searched HikeWNC 30's 40's 50's: Meetup only (Waynesville area listing).
Searched song circle + Doug Norton + Turgua: only MX/ExploreAsheville listings; no page for the circle or its host.
ncintegrativewellness.com is the host massage/acupuncture practice with no book club page; Meetup only for the club.
Searched CONNECT AVL + book club titles: Meetup only; results were unrelated PROpel AVL / AVLmeetup.
Searched avl.js/avljs: Meetup only (~412 members); avljs.com/.org/.dev don't resolve. Educational tech meetup, not networking.
Searched Art Folk/ArtFolk Weaverville + social: only Town of Weaverville single-event pages and MX. No group page.
Searched: only library calendar event pages, burbio and the general Pack Memorial branch page. No program page.
